cohort: 150 mothers with known diabetes aged over 18 years who gave birth at PNS SHIFA Hospital, Karachi, Pakistan.
finding: Neonatal hypocalcemia was observed in 20.7% of infants born to diabetic mothers.
mod_finding: The frequency of neonatal hypocalcemia was higher in cesarean births (62% of the cohort had c-sections), but the association was not statistically significant (p-value not provided).
